content:
这是什么？What is it

这是一个大杂烩扩展包，主要内容是各种游戏动画中的武器，偶尔也会加入一些现实中的武器。

部分枪械右上角可以看到红色角标，表示该枪使用了TACZ默认包的动画或模型；其余内容则是作者自制的动作，质量中规中矩但花样更多，例如汉阳造的抛接动作。

This pack is a mash-up themed gun pack, mainly the weapons from games, also some real guns involved.

You can see a red mark on the top right corner of some contents, that means these guns are using animation from tacz default gun pack. The rest of these contents, are using handmade animations by me. Not very high quality, but maybe having some interesting ideas

都有什么？What it have

本扩展包首发内容包括9把长短枪支、11个配件、两种专属弹药，以及一份“致使用者的简信”。另外，本包中几乎所有物品都有简介，名称和简介内容均实现了英文本地化全覆盖，内容均由作者人工翻译。

The first release contents of this pack involved 9 weapons, 11 attachments, two kinds of ammo, and an "A text for the user".

One more things: almost everything in this pack has its describe text (only in tacz 1.0.3 or above)

怎么下载？How to download

在标题下方简介上方的“Description”一栏中找到“Files”，点击它即可跳转到下载页面。在页面中点击文件列表顶部的“Blue-tin cookie gun pack”文件进行下载。通常该文件为最新版本。

Click the “Files” to open download page, and file shows at the top of the file list is to download. This file is usually the latest version.

如何使用？How to use

请确认您已成功安装任意游戏版本的TACZ模组（模组版本需为1.0.3及以上），并成功运行游戏。之后将下载好的文件拖入“（游戏文件夹）\config\tacz\custom”目录中，无需解压。最后在游戏内使用重载指令 /tacz reload 重载模组内容以加载新的扩展包。重新进入游戏也可以。

Make sure you have already downloaded the right version of tacz mod, tacz v1.0.3 or above, and the game is running well. Then draw the file you downloaded to “xxxx\config\tacz\custom”, no need to unzip. After all, using /tacz reload or restart the game to load new pack

遇到问题，如何反馈？Sends some feedback

为了高效清晰地反馈问题，这里提供了一份标准格式，填空即可，见下。建议将日志打包上传至网盘或复制至在线剪贴板等，以便于查看。

注意：TACZ是电脑端Java版我的世界的模组，使用模拟器在手机上运行可能会出现意想不到的问题，此类问题不予受理。如遇问题，请自行解决。

For efficient and clear feedback on issues, here is a standard format, just fill in the blanks, see below. It is recommended to package the log and upload it to a web drive or copy it to an online clipboard, etc. for easy viewing.
